title: Problem brief: stakeholders, personas, current-process evidence, user stories, misuse cases, success metrics
acceptance_criteria: Every persona maps to user stories with acceptance criteria; misuse cases each name a design response; ten measurable gates

title: Design pack: C4 diagrams, sequence diagrams, state machine, database and feature schemas, ADRs
acceptance_criteria: C4 levels 1-3; three sequence diagrams; review-queue state machine; ER diagram; eight ADRs each with the rejected alternatives

title: Threat model: adversary capabilities, attack taxonomy, STRIDE, out-of-scope threats
acceptance_criteria: Six attack families with capabilities and costs; STRIDE per component; out-of-scope threats with reasons

title: Requirements traceability matrix against the portfolio brief
acceptance_criteria: Every portfolio requirement maps to evidence (file, test or command) and a status; gaps stated honestly

title: Three independent feature families with clean interfaces
acceptance_criteria: 265 features in a fixed order across email (125), URL (107) and behavioural (33) families; the ordered list is saved with the model and verified on load

title: Leakage-safe campaign-grouped split with an audit that can fail the build
acceptance_criteria: No campaign appears in both train and test; near-duplicates scrubbed; training refuses to run if the audit fails

title: Calibrated fusion over heterogeneous members
acceptance_criteria: Four members fused on a disjoint stacking pool and calibrated on a third pool; ECE <= 0.08 (gate G4)

title: Threat-informed attack taxonomy and semantic-preserving transform suite
acceptance_criteria: Each transform preserves the payload; transforms cannot fabricate the victim's history; budgeted decision-based attacker

title: Named, individually ablatable defensive controls
acceptance_criteria: Six controls (D-NORM, D-URL, D-ADVTRAIN, D-ENSEMBLE, D-ABSTAIN, D-VELOCITY), each switchable and measured by the defence ablation

title: Baseline comparison: rule checklist and conventional text model
acceptance_criteria: B0 (37 rules) and B1 (TF-IDF + logistic regression) evaluated on the same split, clean and under attack; gates G8 and G9

title: Evaluation dossier with automated go/no-go gates
acceptance_criteria: phishguard evaluate writes evaluation.json/md and exits non-zero if any of 10 gates fails; CI runs it

title: Serving API with authentication, audit trail and human oversight
acceptance_criteria: Role-based API keys; content-free audit record per decision; feedback endpoint; 401/403/429 behaviour tested

title: Analyst console with evidence and feedback
acceptance_criteria: Assess a message, read plain-language evidence and member scores, record feedback; no build step

title: Containerised deployment, observability and CI
acceptance_criteria: docker compose up --build trains and serves; Prometheus, Grafana and alert rules provisioned; CI runs lint, tests, security scan, gates and a container smoke test

title: Model card, threat model and residual-risk register
acceptance_criteria: Model card generated from the registry and the latest evaluation; residual risk per attack family

title: Review queue with case states, owners, priorities and SLAs
acceptance_criteria: Only the assignee or an admin may act on a claimed case (403 otherwise); concurrent claims give one winner (409); P1 1 h, P2 4 h, P3 24 h; every transition is an event

title: Reporter role and report page for email users
acceptance_criteria: A reporter can report a message and read the outcome of their own reports; never sees a score or band; cannot scan

title: Modality ablation quantifying each family's contribution
acceptance_criteria: All seven family combinations trained and evaluated on the same split

title: Defence ablation quantifying each control's contribution
acceptance_criteria: Each control removed in turn, model retrained and attacked

title: Per-decision counterfactual explanations
acceptance_criteria: Evidence items state how the score would change if a feature were normal; mitigating evidence shown

title: Adversarial probe endpoint for post-deployment assurance
acceptance_criteria: Admin-only; audited; alert when a probe evades

title: Public-corpus loaders and fetcher with provenance and terms
acceptance_criteria: mbox/maildir loaders; corpus audit for era and label confounds; fetch-public refuses without terms acknowledgement and records SHA-256 provenance

title: Hard-case benchmark (PG-HARD) and expected-cost model
acceptance_criteria: 192 curated hard records; silent delivery and false blocks against both baselines; thresholds priced

title: Request tracing with W3C trace context and per-stage timings
acceptance_criteria: traceparent continued or started; Server-Timing and stage_ms on every scan; trace id on the audit record; no content in traces

title: Load test and resource measurements
acceptance_criteria: Throughput, p50/p95/p99, errors and memory at 1-8 concurrent requests and with 1-2 processes; p95 within 150 ms up to 8 in flight

title: Statistical drift detection with a calibrated false-alarm rate
acceptance_criteria: Alarm levels calibrated on stable campaign windows; console, API and CLI

title: Content-addressed dataset versions and optional MLflow tracking
acceptance_criteria: Fingerprint of train and test sets in the manifest and the dossier; --mlflow logs params, metrics and artefacts when installed

title: Transformer member (DistilBERT)
acceptance_criteria: Guarded behind the transformer extra; off by default; must beat the ablation to be enabled

title: Temporal-drift evaluation over a longer horizon
acceptance_criteria: Train on earlier campaigns, test on later ones, on real longitudinal data

title: Active learning from the analyst queue
acceptance_criteria: Deliberately not built: it is the poisoning vector OOS-3

title: Evaluate the email+url configuration on the organisation's own labelled mail
acceptance_criteria: False-positive rate inside the G3 budget on real mail; by sender language and for new domains (RAI-1, RAI-2)

title: Independent red-team exercise against the deployed API
acceptance_criteria: A tester with no knowledge of the transform list tries to reach ALLOW within a query budget; findings added to the suite

title: Supplier register as behavioural context
acceptance_criteria: A known supplier's new domain is treated as a relationship, not a stranger; HN-REBRAND false blocks fall

title: Single sign-on (OIDC) for the console
acceptance_criteria: Console login through the identity provider; roles mapped from groups; API keys kept for machine clients

title: OpenTelemetry exporter for traces
acceptance_criteria: Spans exported over OTLP when a collector is configured; in-process ring kept for air-gapped installs

title: PostgreSQL audit store for multi-node deployments
acceptance_criteria: Same DecisionStore interface; migration of schema version 2; chosen when more than one node writes
